Dana: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A  can we get concise delivery windows for Console canary + autoscale, API sampling defaults, and Optimize quant suggestions? Need to sync with sprint planning.
Ravi: Short bullets: Console canary beta (UI + basic autoscale) targeted mid-Q3, GA if stable by end-Q3. API sampling defaults: opt-in flag in early Q3, default roll in later Q3 with deprecation timeline. Optimize quant suggestions: per-model in late Q3, then workload rollups later.
Mei: Note on Console: some infra work (cache eviction + rollout rollback hooks) is blocking GA; that's why beta may be behind a flag to pilot teams.
Dana: Can we get pilot access for a couple of platform teams? would cut testing time.
Ravi: Yes  pilot signups will open tomorrow. We'll cap initial pilots to 6 teams. I'll post the form to #eng-platform and tag people.
Ollie: for API change, will existing SDKs need updates?
Ravi: We'll ship a `sampling_mode` param. SDKs will default to `legacy` until we bump defaults 3 months after the announcement. No breaking change.
Dana: will Optimize UI show recommended quant levels (4-bit/8-bit) per model in the pilot?
Mei: Pilot will surface recommended quant profiles per-model and an estimated cost delta. Full UI for workload-level recommendations is planned after pilot feedback.
DeployBot: roadmap/q3 updated by Ravi at 1801234710.
Dana: thanks  please share links to the pilot form and the pre-read so teams can prep.
Ravi: will do  sending links now and adding a short pre-read to the calendar invite.
Mei: office hours demo scheduled Friday 11am PT  we'll walk through canary YAML, autoscale knobs, and Optimize suggestions.
Dana: perfect  appreciate the clarity.
Ravi: action items: 1) publish pilot signup link, 2) post timeline doc, 3) SDK owners to review sampling_mode shim.
Dana: I'll triage our infra team's interest today. :thumbsup:
